newsitem.title: UK: Guatemala to launch $150 mln 10-yr bond next week.
newsitem.headline: Guatemala to launch $150 mln 10-yr bond next week.

text.p: Guatemala is expected to launch a $150 million 10-year bond early next week, bankers said on Friday, marking its debut on the international bond markets.
Spread talk was 240 to 250 basis points over U.S. Treasury notes. BankBoston is lead manager of the deal.
Guatemala has held roadshows in Europe and the U.S. for the deal, and bankers said demand for the paper was strong. But they said Guatemala was unlikely to increase the issue size.
Moody's Investors Service has rated Guatemala's long-term foreign currency debt Ba2. -- Aline van Duyn, London Newsroom +44 171 542 7748
